### CVE-2021-4235 — Denial of service in gopkg.in/yaml.v2
- Assigner: Go | Published: 2022-12-27 | Updated: 2025-04-11 | Max CVSS: 5.5
- CWE: CWE 400: Uncontrolled Resource Consumption
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 5.5 MEDIUM `CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=poc, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=partial

Due to unbounded alias chasing, a maliciously crafted YAML file can cause the system to consume significant system resources. If parsing user input, this may be used as a denial of service vector.

### CVE-2021-4236 — Panic or authentication bypass in github.com/ecnepsnai/web
- Assigner: Go | Published: 2022-12-27 | Updated: 2025-04-11 | Max CVSS: 9.8
- CWE: CWE-400: Uncontrolled Resource Consumption
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 9.8 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=total

Web Sockets do not execute any AuthenticateMethod methods which may be set, leading to a nil pointer dereference if the returned UserData pointer is assumed to be non-nil, or authentication bypass. This issue only affects WebSockets with an AuthenticateMethod hook. Request handlers that do not explicitly use WebSockets are not vulnerable.

Affected:
- github.com/ecnepsnai/web / github.com/ecnepsnai/web: affected 1.4.0 <1.5.2 (semver)

References:
- https://github.com/ecnepsnai/web/commit/5a78f8d5c41ce60dcf9f61aaf47a7a8dc3e0002f
- https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2021-0107

### CVE-2021-4238 — Insufficient randomness in github.com/Masterminds/goutils
- Assigner: Go | Published: 2022-12-27 | Updated: 2025-04-11 | Max CVSS: 9.1
- CWE: CWE 330: Use of Insufficiently Random Values
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 9.1 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=total

Randomly-generated alphanumeric strings contain significantly less entropy than expected. The RandomAlphaNumeric and CryptoRandomAlphaNumeric functions always return strings containing at least one digit from 0 to 9. This significantly reduces the amount of entropy in short strings generated by these functions.

Affected:
- github.com/Masterminds/goutils / github.com/Masterminds/goutils: affected 0 <1.1.1 (semver)

References:
- https://github.com/Masterminds/goutils/commit/869801f20f9f1e7ecdbdb6422049d8241270d5e1
- https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2022-0411

### CVE-2021-4239 — Weak encryption and denial of service in github.com/flynn/noise
- Assigner: Go | Published: 2022-12-27 | Updated: 2025-04-14 | Max CVSS: 7.5
- CWE: CWE 400: Uncontrolled Resource Consumption
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 7.5 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:H/A:N`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=partial

The Noise protocol implementation suffers from weakened cryptographic security after encrypting 2^64 messages, and a potential denial of service attack. After 2^64 (~18.4 quintillion) messages are encrypted with the Encrypt function, the nonce counter will wrap around, causing multiple messages to be encrypted with the same key and nonce. In a separate issue, the Decrypt function increments the nonce state even when it fails to decrypt a message. If an attacker can provide an invalid input to the Decrypt function, this will cause the nonce state to desynchronize between the peers, resulting in a failure to encrypt all subsequent messages.

Affected:
- github.com/flynn/noise / github.com/flynn/noise: affected 0 <1.0.0 (semver)

References:
- https://github.com/flynn/noise/pull/44
- https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2022-0425
